title: +*INTRODUCTION TO WOMEN, GENDER, AND SEXUALITY STUDIES
description: Introduces women, gender, and sexuality studies. Focuses on the lives and status of women in society and explores ways institutions such as family, work, media, law and religion affect different groups of women. Explores issues of gender, race, class, age, sexual orientation, size and ability from multidisciplinary perspectives.
